name: Runist Oracle
body:
A seer from a warrior culture, the runist relies on the power of runes to draw auspices and guide her people. She often uses the variant runic auspice rule instead of an oracle curse.

Class Skills: The runist doesn’t gain any bonus class skills from her mystery.

Bonus Spells: These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels: runecasting (3rd), greater runecasting (6th).

Revelation
Runic Caster (Sp)

The runist adds all spells with “rune” or “runes” in their name to her spell list. She still must know these spells in order to cast them.

Auspicious Spread (Ex)

Every time the runist would gain a revelation from her mystery, she can choose to gain the Cast Rune feat instead. A revelation already replaced through an archetype cannot be further replaced this way.

Recommended Mysteries: lore, nature, occult.
